_comment: Synthetic sample register capture for the simulator. Plausible values for a WaterFurnace 7 Series (variable-speed) at light cooling load; not a capture from any specific unit. Registers 1112/1113/1116 hold the ABC's -999.9 sentinel (0xD8F1 = 55537) for sensors not fitted. The IZ2 zone block (31007+) is synthesized by the simulator, so it is intentionally absent here.
